summary: Tested UI redesign of /setup/keys (BYOK modal wizard) + Landing 'What's new' section. All items in review passed. Backend endpoints preserved and working (/api/auth/me cookie auth, /api/user-keys/status, /api/user-keys/verify).
critical_code_review_comments: Review request refers to the page as '/setup-keys' but the actual React route is '/setup/keys' (App.js line 98). Not a bug — no code references '/setup-keys' — but worth noting for future spec accuracy.
Setup progress pill shows 'X of 5 connected' counting only services where status.source === 'you'. For fresh test user with admin-provided keys, this correctly shows '0 of 5 connected'.
seed_data_creation: Created one test user + session in test_database via mongosh (see test_credentials).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The route is /setup/keys (not /setup-keys). Cookie auth via session_token cookie (Lax, secure). Fresh test users see admin-provided BYOK keys as source='admin' — the setup-progress counter only increments for source='you'. BYOK modal verify endpoint /api/user-keys/verify works and returns {ok:false,detail:'ElevenLabs rejected the key (401)'} for fake key; UI renders red error box with data-testid='byok-modal-verify-result'.
